bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-15 | Third-Party Courier Booking and Booking Recovery

bpmn:process.name: Third-Party Courier Booking and Booking Recovery
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-15 and full catalog boundaries; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.16 FR-DEL-01,08-11,14,17; FR-FUL-18-20; supporting FR-FUL-23,26, NFR-SEC-14, NFR-REL-01-05 and BR-26-27,34. Implementation: index.html loads app/delivery-state.js V.reason/book/refresh, app/delivery-tracking.js T.book, app/owner-orders.js, app/earnings-allocation.js and app/subscription-batches.js. Existing BPMN-11/12/13/14 reviewed for detail and reuse; SRS governs differences: FR-DEL-10 restricts booking initiation to Admin/Owner though the in-memory prototype permits Staff; provider outcomes are simulated in the prototype, and its booked state must not be taken as proof a rider is already assigned. Scope is one paid ready standard order or weekly subscription fulfillment using courier delivery. Cake handoff belongs to BPMN-17 and pickup to BPMN-14. Authentication is a BPMN-26 precondition; enforce owner-only operational authorization before accessing/acting on a booking. Internal Owner/System lanes share sequence flows; the separate black-box Lalamove participant uses message flows for supported booking and reconciliation exchanges. No generic broadcast/signal event is introduced. All local checks and failure/recovery outcomes are visible. External BPMN-12 call uses validation-only mode and relative import; no valid saved owner split is re-entered. Cross-file execution/navigation is host-dependent, not a promise of bpmn.io drill-down. No checkout address/quotation repetition, weekly payment, automated refund, automatic retry loop, booking cancellation request, rider tracking or delivery completion is invented. Initial checkout eligibility/fees are BPMN-02/18; subsequent tracking/completion and failed/cancelled status updates are BPMN-16. One booking attempt/fulfillment is saved consistently before provider submission, with allocation lock; status/identity survive ambiguous provider or persistence failures. Never release a possibly active booking merely because the response is lost. Supported batch booking operates independently per fulfillment. Existing BPMNs are unchanged.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Owner requests booking or recovery review

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Check owner access; load fulfillment and booking history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Enforce authenticated Admin/Owner access before exposing records or initiating/reconciling actions. Read paid/status/type/method, stored checkout delivery information, saved allocations, version, operation identity and current/prior provider references. Invalid permission/missing record is returned as ineligible, not disclosed as operational details.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check owner, courier scope and new/recovery prerequisites
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-01,08-11,14. Require Admin/Owner and a standard order or individual subscription fulfillment using delivery. A new attempt requires verified paid/current Ready state and complete stored order/destination data. For pending/unresolved recovery, preserve access to the existing attempt even if current operational state changed; this authorizes lookup only, never a new booking. Existing active bookings continue to BPMN-16, not another creation. Recovery of an existing attempt uses its stored identity even if current eligibility has changed; no new request is authorized by lookup alone. Missing/invalid saved delivery information requires review, never silent replacement of a confirmed address. Original checkout Maps/service-area/fee decisions are not rerun here.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain permission, type, status or delivery-data issue
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Reject unsupported action and preserve all records, booking state and locks. No new payment or automatic change of method/address. Staff cannot initiate booking under FR-DEL-10.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Existing active booking retained — BPMN-16
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Booked/in-transit or other established active booking is not submitted again. Retain allocation lock. Existing tracking and completion belong to BPMN-16. Delivered/completed records cannot become new bookings through this process.

bpmn:userTask.name: Review saved delivery details and request a new booking
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: Only no prior attempt or definitively failed/cancelled prior booking may proceed, while fulfillment remains incomplete and otherwise eligible. Review saved checkout destination and delivery data. Subscription address remains agreed for all four fulfillments; actual fee differences are borne by bakery under BR-27. No new customer charge/refund. Owner may edit unlocked allocations separately through BPMN-12; no forced split modal.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Request cancelled; saved state retained
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Cancelling the local confirmation creates no courier booking and changes no allocation/lock. This is not a provider cancellation API operation.

bpmn:callActivity.name: Refer to BPMN-12 — Validate saved owner allocations
bpmn:callActivity.bpmn:documentation: Call k406:Process_16 in validation-only mode with owner account, fulfillment identity, expected version and action=courier booking. Validate saved line allocations, eligible owners/percentages, permissions, version and lock compatibility. Return exact rejection reason. Valid saved splits are reused without manual re-entry; optional supported combined drafts must remain atomic with protected changes.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Return permission, stale-version, split or lock reason
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Reject this attempt, preserve latest saved state and require refresh/review or a separately allowed BPMN-12 correction. No provider request is sent.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Recheck controls; save pending attempt and allocation lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-17; FR-FUL-18-20; NFR-SEC-14, NFR-REL-03,05. Atomically recheck owner permission, version, paid Ready state, complete valid allocations, stored destination and absence of another pending/active/unresolved attempt. Persist one attempt identity, saved request context, prior-attempt link/history and pending lock/timestamp before calling provider. Failed local commit sends nothing and preserves prior state. Concurrent matching attempts reuse existing record; conflicting/stale attempts reject. Do not independently commit owner edits that conflict with the booking transaction.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain conflict/save failure; do not contact provider
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: No request is sent without a saved consistent attempt/lock. Preserve independently committed newer booking state. Review and refresh before another authorized request; no blind provider retry.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Submit stored booking information to Lalamove; resolve response
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-11. Use the saved order/destination information and saved attempt identity. Preserve response/provider reference and diagnosis. Successful creation means a booking exists, not necessarily an assigned rider or completed delivery. Classify definitive failed/cancelled outcomes separately from timeout, lost response or ambiguous result. If provider may have accepted but persistence fails, keep unresolved attempt/lock for reconciliation, not a new creation. Do not assume a provider-specific idempotency capability absent from requirements.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save established provider booking and retain allocation lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Save provider booking reference/status with attempt/history and current version consistently. Preserve agreed delivery data, original product amounts and confirmed subscription commitment. A failed local save after provider creation must retain unresolved pending state/lock; no new request is safe until reconciliation. Completion and completion timestamp are not recorded by booking.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Booking established; continue tracking in BPMN-16

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save confirmed Failed/Cancelled; permit eligible review
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Only a definitive provider failure/cancellation permits this result. Preserve attempt/provider history. Release the booking-related allocation lock only if fulfillment is incomplete and no other pending/active/unresolved booking exists. Retain Ready state, paid purchase and delivery information. Allocation edit/rebooking are allowed only after normal eligibility checks. Do not cancel the paid fulfillment or refund automatically.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Definitive failure; owner may review and rebook

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Retain unresolved attempt and allocation lock; show recovery status
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Timeout/lost response, ambiguous provider outcome or persistence failure after possible provider acceptance: retain attempt identity, any reference/request evidence, saved pending state and allocation lock. Explain that another booking cannot be submitted. Safe recovery uses existing-attempt reconciliation, never blind creation or unlocking. Log diagnosis without exposing secrets.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Outcome unresolved; reconcile before any new booking

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Resolve existing attempt with Lalamove; do not create another
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: NFR-REL-01-03; FR-DEL-17. For pending/unresolved saved attempt, use preserved identity/provider reference and supported provider status lookup to determine its outcome. Never submit a new booking as a status query. If lookup is unavailable or cannot establish an outcome, retain unresolved state/lock and require further reconciliation. No fabricated cancellation or provider behavior is assumed. If recovery establishes delivery progress, BPMN-16 processes tracking/completion.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save recovered booking reference/status; retain lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Associate discovered booking with the original attempt, preserve saved identity/history and current version, and retain active/unresolved lock as applicable. Never create another booking. On save conflict/failure keep unresolved saved state and lock for further reconciliation; do not assert successful recovery.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save definitive Failed/Cancelled; retain history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Recovered provider evidence establishes the prior attempt failed/cancelled. Save consistently and allow review/edit/rebooking only while incomplete and without another pending/active/unresolved booking. If this save fails, keep prior unresolved state/lock; do not authorize new booking. Fresh booking requires owner confirmation and all new-attempt checks.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Prior failure resolved; owner may start fresh review
Still unresolved; keep lock and block new booking
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Lookup or local save could not safely resolve the attempt. Preserve prior state, attempt evidence and lock. Safe reconciliation can be requested later. No automatic retry interval or maximum count is invented.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Booking eligibility Admin/Owner only (FR-DEL-10). Paid Ready standard/subscription delivery. Use saved order and destination data. Each subscription week has its own booking. BPMN-02/18 already handled checkout address eligibility and fee quotation. No cakes, pickup or automatic checkout booking.

Refer to BPMN-12 Validate saved owner selections, permission, version and locks; no forced owner-split modal. Pending/active/unresolved booking locks allocations. Definitive failure/cancellation may permit review only while incomplete. Staff acting does not earn an owner allocation.

Safe provider submission Save attempt identity + pending lock before provider call. Recheck current controls at commit. Unknown result ≠ confirmed failure. Retain evidence and lock; reconcile the existing attempt before another booking. No blind creation retry after response loss.

Business boundaries An established booking does not mean Delivered or that a rider is already assigned. BPMN-16 owns tracking and completion. No live rider-location tracking. Subscription address remains agreed; bakery absorbs later actual-fee differences (BR-26/27). No new customer charge/refund. Failed/cancelled attempts require fresh owner review before rebooking.
